title: Cloudkeep
tagline: 飞艇探索浮岛，展示飞行控制、平滑追随镜头与模型制作流程

examples.title: 飞行与追随镜头
examples.one_liner: 驾驶飞艇，对比平滑与直接跟随，观察镜头避障
examples.one_liner_en: Fly an airship, compare smooth and direct following, and watch camera collision avoidance.

examples.title: 模型与远景减面
examples.one_liner: 旋转查看 18 个模型，对比远景版本、线框与三角形数量
examples.one_liner_en: Rotate 18 models and compare distant versions, wireframes and triangle counts.

examples.title: 喂食、捕获与生态
examples.one_liner: 投食引来生物，加速惊扰，按住 Q 捕获并观察金币与回归
examples.one_liner_en: Lure creatures with food, startle them by speeding up, and hold Q to capture; watch coins and returns.

examples.title: 云海与入云雾效
examples.one_liner: 飞入六团体积云，观察雾气收紧，对比入云前后的视野
examples.one_liner_en: Fly into six volumetric clouds and compare visibility as the fog closes in.

tagline_en: Explore floating islands by airship, with flight controls, a smooth follow camera and a model-building workflow.
